query:
SELECT o.id AS "id!: OrderId", o.customer AS "customer!: CustomerName", o.status AS "status!: OrderStatus",
                  o.version AS "version!",
                  count(l.position) AS "line_count!",
                  coalesce(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price_cents), 0)::bigint AS "total_cents!",
                  min(l.sku) AS first_sku
             FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
            WHERE o.client_id = $1
            GROUP BY o.id
            ORDER BY o.id
